title: Decision nodes carry structured slugs in the form DEC-<AREA>-<TOPIC>-<NNN>
context: Decision identifiers must be machine-readable for linking and human-readable for discovery. The alternative would be unstructured slugs like `auth-decision-3` or using only UUIDs.
decision: Every decision node carries a slug matching the pattern `DEC-<AREA>-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` where AREA and TOPIC are uppercase letters only and NNN is exactly three digits. The structured slug is the `slug` field (not the `id`), unique within the decision collection.
consequences: Decisions are discoverable and linkable by their structured name; the pattern enforces categorization; areas and topics can be extracted for grouping and reporting; the slug cannot be used as a fallback identifier because it is strictly formatted.
